intro: PowerSource Workbench includes open-source software. This page lists in-tree and runtime components, then every direct npm production dependency shipped with the desktop app. Each project remains the property of its authors and is used under the license shown.
footnote: Transitive packages keep the licenses declared in their own package.json files. Refresh this npm list with npm run oss:notices after dependency changes.

items.electron: Desktop shell that hosts the renderer.
items.v8: JavaScript engine used by Chromium and Node.js.
items.onlyOffice: Docs / Sheets / Slides editor (Document Server on the VPS).
items.hermes: Harness memory, skills, and jobs.json file contract (in-tree kernel).
items.mihomo: Clash Meta core used by the Clash feature.
items.clashVerge: Clash settings and proxy UI (pruned from Clash Verge Rev).
items.univer: Office data model used for Word / Excel / PowerPoint file exchange. Not the live Docs / Sheets / Slides editor.
items.monaco: Code editor used by Aura and related tools.
items.mermaid: Diagram renderer used by the editor.
items.mui: Component library used by Clash and related surfaces.
items.katex: Math renderer used by the editor.
items.highlightjs: Syntax highlighting used by the editor.
items.lucide: Icon paths used in the desktop UI.
